fields.title: Snapchat profile / spotlight / highlight / lens record
fields.description: Every record carries _input, _source, _scrapedAt and recordType. recordType discriminates the payload: PROFILE (public profile + related accounts), SPOTLIGHT_VIDEO (one Spotlight post with its view count), HIGHLIGHT (a Story/highlight with every snap), LENS (an AR lens), TRENDING_SPOTLIGHT (the public Spotlight feed), SURFACE (reference mode) and ERROR. Snapchat's untouched object always ships under _raw, because it adds and removes keys without notice.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The username or hub that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-next-data when the record came from Snapchat's SSR payload, 'none' on failure rows.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was emitted.

recordType.title: Record type
recordType.description: PROFILE | SPOTLIGHT_VIDEO | HIGHLIGHT | LENS | TRENDING_SPOTLIGHT | SURFACE | ERROR.

displayName.title: Display name
displayName.description: Name shown on the profile, e.g. 'NASA'.

bio.title: Bio
bio.description: Profile description as written by the account.

websiteUrl.title: Website
websiteUrl.description: Outbound link published on the profile.

address.title: Address
address.description: Address published by business profiles. Empty for most accounts.

subscriberCount.title: Subscribers
subscriberCount.description: Subscriber count as an integer. Snapchat publishes 0 for accounts that hide it, which is different from null (field absent).

badgeName.title: Badge
badgeName.description: 'official' for verified accounts, 'none' otherwise. Unrecognised badge IDs pass through as their number.

isVerified.title: Verified
isVerified.description: True when the account carries an official badge.

squareHeroImageUrl.title: Hero image
squareHeroImageUrl.description: Square hero image published on the profile.

snapcodeImageUrl.title: Snapcode
snapcodeImageUrl.description: SVG snapcode URL that opens the account in the app.

hasStory.title: Has live story
hasStory.description: Whether the account had a public Story live at scrape time.

hasCuratedHighlights.title: Has highlights
hasCuratedHighlights.description: Whether the account publishes curated highlights.

hasSpotlightHighlights.title: Has Spotlight
hasSpotlightHighlights.description: Whether the account publishes Spotlight videos.

createdAt.title: Created at
createdAt.description: Profile creation time, when Snapchat publishes it.

updatedAt.title: Updated at
updatedAt.description: Last profile update time, when Snapchat publishes it.

lensCount.title: Lenses
lensCount.description: How many AR lenses the profile document carried.

curatedHighlightCount.title: Highlights
curatedHighlightCount.description: How many curated highlights the profile document carried.

spotlightCount.title: Spotlight videos
spotlightCount.description: How many Spotlight videos the profile document carried.

relatedAccountCount.title: Related accounts
relatedAccountCount.description: How many related accounts Snapchat listed for this profile.

relatedAccounts.title: Related accounts
relatedAccounts.description: List of {username, title, badge, profilePictureUrl, profileUrl} that Snapchat itself links from this profile. Feed these back into 'related' mode to expand a niche.

relatedDepth.title: Related depth
relatedDepth.description: How many expansion levels away from your seed this profile was found (related mode).

spotlightIndex.title: Spotlight index
spotlightIndex.description: Position of the video in the account's Spotlight list, newest first.

storyId.title: Story ID
storyId.description: Snapchat's identifier for the story or Spotlight post.

highlightId.title: Highlight ID
highlightId.description: Identifier for the highlight the snaps belong to.

subtitle.title: Subtitle
subtitle.description: Secondary label shown under the title.

description.title: Description
description.description: Video description published with the post.

caption.title: Caption
caption.description: Text caption embedded in the video, when present.

viewCount.title: Views
viewCount.description: View count for the Spotlight video. This is the number Snapchat publishes on the public page.

shareCount.title: Shares
shareCount.description: Share count published with the post.

uploadedAt.title: Uploaded at
uploadedAt.description: UTC upload time of the Spotlight video.

videoUrl.title: Video URL
videoUrl.description: Direct media URL for the post. Snapchat's CDN links are signed and expire.

thumbnailUrl.title: Thumbnail
thumbnailUrl.description: Preview image for the post, highlight or lens.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Keywords Snapchat attached to the video.

hashtags.title: Hashtags
hashtags.description: Hashtags attached to the Spotlight post.

contextCards.title: Context cards
contextCards.description: Attribution cards shown on the post: original sound, creator profile, lens used.

creatorUsername.title: Creator username
creatorUsername.description: Account that published the post or lens.

creatorDisplayName.title: Lens creator
creatorDisplayName.description: Display name of the lens creator.

creatorProfileUrl.title: Creator profile URL
creatorProfileUrl.description: Profile page of the lens creator, when published.

creatorFollowerCount.title: Creator followers
creatorFollowerCount.description: Follower count carried on the post's creator object. Often 0 on Spotlight payloads.

creatorUrl.title: Creator URL
creatorUrl.description: Profile URL of the post's creator.

highlightIndex.title: Highlight index
highlightIndex.description: Position of the highlight within its list.

storyType.title: Story type ID
storyType.description: Raw story type integer from Snapchat.

storyTypeName.title: Story type
storyTypeName.description: CURATED_HIGHLIGHT | SPOTLIGHT_HIGHLIGHT, or the raw ID when Snapchat introduces a new one.

emoji.title: Emoji
emoji.description: Emoji label attached to the highlight.

videoTrackUrl.title: Video track URL
videoTrackUrl.description: Combined video track for the highlight, when published.

canonicalUrl.title: Canonical URL
canonicalUrl.description: Public snapchat.com URL for the story.

snapCount.title: Snaps
snapCount.description: How many snaps this story or highlight contains.

firstSnapAt.title: First snap at
firstSnapAt.description: Timestamp of the earliest snap carrying one.

snaps.title: Snaps
snaps.description: List of {snapIndex, snapId, mediaType, mediaUrl, previewUrl, timestamp, isSponsored}. Media URLs are signed CDN links and expire.

lensName.title: Lens name
lensName.description: Public name of the AR lens.

scannableUuid.title: Scannable UUID
scannableUuid.description: UUID used by snapcodes that unlock the lens.

isOfficialSnapLens.title: Official lens
isOfficialSnapLens.description: True for lenses published by Snap itself rather than a community creator.

category.title: Lens category
category.description: Lens hub category the chart was read from (top-lenses mode).

searchTags.title: Search tags
searchTags.description: Tags the creator attached to the lens.

previewVideoUrl.title: Lens preview video
previewVideoUrl.description: Short preview video of the lens.

iconUrl.title: Lens icon
iconUrl.description: Icon shown in the lens carousel.

scannableImageUrl.title: Snapcode image
scannableImageUrl.description: Snapcode image that unlocks the lens.

unlockUrl.title: Unlock URL
unlockUrl.description: Deep link that opens the lens in the Snapchat app.

lensResource.title: Lens resource
lensResource.description: Raw lens resource object, when Snapchat publishes one.

lastUpdatedEpoch.title: Lens updated (epoch)
lastUpdatedEpoch.description: Last lens update as published by Snapchat. Often 0.

feedIndex.title: Feed position
feedIndex.description: Rank of the post in the public Spotlight feed at scrape time (trending mode).

contentSource.title: Content source
contentSource.description: How the Spotlight hub sourced this post.

surface.title: Surface
surface.description: Which public surface was probed (reference mode).

url.title: Probed URL
url.description: Exact URL used for the probe (reference mode).

isAvailable.title: Available
isAvailable.description: Whether that surface returned a usable payload right now.

sample.title: Sample
sample.description: Counts measured during the probe, as evidence the surface really carries data.

_buildId.title: Frontend build ID
_buildId.description: Snapchat's deployed frontend build. Makes payload-shape drift diagnosable from the dataset.

_raw.title: Raw upstream object
_raw.description: Snapchat's untouched object for this record, so nothing is lost when upstream adds keys this Actor does not name yet.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across every record type.
